coverage_note: Selected reporting economies and six copper HS4 headings; not exhaustive world trade. Imports and exports are distinct observations and must never be summed together. Missing routes are not zero. Partner countries do not locate mines, smelters, final users or disposal facilities.
method: Annual original-classification HS4 source netWgt kg / 1,000. Main flows retain positive, non-estimated net weights only. All source rows including estimated/missing weights and aggregate partners remain in observations.json and immutable raw snapshots. No value-to-mass conversion, contained-copper conversion, interpolation or mirror filling.
mass_warning: These are tonnes calculated only from the source netWgt field, not verified contained-copper tonnes. Ore/concentrate quantity conventions may differ by reporter; Canadian HS2603 national export quantity may be assay/metal-content weight, and its Comtrade netWgt equals qty. Canadian ore basis is unresolved; do not label it gross ore mass. Mattes, alloys and scrap have variable copper content. Do not add supply-chain stages or compare directly with mine output.
reporting_warning: Select reported_flow X for exporter reports or M for importer reports. Reporter controls the observation basis. An importer report is not substituted for an exporter report. Bilateral asymmetries are expected.
license_note: UN Comtrade public preview, bounded selected queries, source attribution required. Under 100,000 rows; public/free-of-charge analytics. Preserved policy/FAQ references accompany this snapshot.
